content.title: Oscars 2025: Where To Watch Live, Hulu/ABC Streaming Info
content.text: Published March 2, 2025, 6:00 p.m. ET A COMPLETE UNKNOWN - Trailer0 seconds of 2 minutes, 24 secondsVolume 0% Former Emmys host Conan O’Brien is moving to the big screen as the prolific funnyman hosts the 2025 Academy Awards! What exactly does the legendary late-night host have in store for us when he takes the stage for the Oscars? “I’m just going to read a lot of very dreary Russian novels,” Conan joked during a recent interview with the New York Times. “‘Crime and Punishment’; ‘Brothers Karamazov’; ‘Notes From Underground.’ I’m going to finish reading them live onstage — aloud. This is an Oscars you don’t want to miss!” Classic Conan. If you don’t want to miss any of the Best Picture nominees, you can read Anna Menta’s helpful Oscar streaming guide on Decider. Where can you watch the 2025 Oscars online? Here’s everything you need to know. Oscars 2025 Start Time/Channel Info: The 2025 Academy Awards air tonight (March 2) from 7:00-10:32 p.m. ET on ABC and Hulu. Preshow coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. ET. The Oscars will be followed by the season premiere of American Idol. Oscars 2025 Red Carpet Start Time Info: E! Countdown to the Red Carpet airs from 2:00-4:00 p.m. ET, followed by E! Live From the Red Carpet from 4:00-6:00 p.m. ET. Red Carpet Rundown: Oscars 2025 will air from 6:30-7:00 p.m. ET on E!. ABC and Hulu’s live red carpet coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. ET. Where To Watch The 2025 Oscars Live: You can watch the 2025 Oscars live on Hulu, ABC.com, or with the ABC app by signing in with a participating TV provider. Once you log in, you can stream the event at abc.com/watch-live or you can select ‘live TV’ in the ABC app. The show will also be broadcast in over 200 territories worldwide, with Oscars.com offering detailed international streaming information. Finally, there’s an American Sign Language (ASL) live stream you can watch on YouTube. How To Watch The Oscars Live Online For Free Without Cable: For the first time, you can stream the Oscars live on Hulu, which offers a 30-day free trial. You can also watch this year’s ceremony with an active subscription to an over-the-top streaming service that offers ABC, including Sling TV, fuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV Stream, and YouTube TV. FuboTV and YouTube TV offer free trials for new subscribers. 2026 OSCARS: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW Photo: ABC/HULU Can’t get enough of the 2026 Oscars?
